rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A Model Context Protocol server that provides AI assistants with direct access to Oracle databases. It exposes three key tools: listing all tables, describing table structures (including columns, data types, and key relationships), and executing read-only SQL queries. The implementation uses Python's oracledb library to handle database connections asynchronously, with connection details securely managed through environment variables. This server enables AI assistants to explore database schemas and retrieve data without requiring direct database access credentials.
